# Discogs takes 9% of your shipping too.

> Free Discogs seller fee calculator: the 9% selling fee on item price plus shipping ($0.10 minimum, $150 maximum), editable payment processing, your payout and profit after postage and cost, the price that hits a target profit, and a fee ladder from $3 singles to $2,500 grails. Nothing leaves your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
